title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E2 — Slumber Party
When Vanessa and Geneva get stranded in the middle of a forest due to a broken down car, Mark is forced to chaperone Nicole's slumber party by himself.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E3 — School's a Drag
Mark gets in an accident with the school's drivers' education car and fears the tough, new principal, P.J. Moore, may discharge him. Sherman Hemsley and Don Cheadle guest star.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E4 — Limpin' Lizards
Nicole gets a part on the "Lester the Lizard and Crocodile Kids" show. When Mark complains about being assigned as the drivers' education teacher, PJ reassigns him to the home economics teacher position.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E5 — Free at Last
When Vanessa is not given the promotion she was promised, she takes Mark's advice to demand her rights and is promptly discharged from her job.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E6 — Father Fairest
When Earvin tells Mark that his greatest wish is to see his long-lost father, Mark locates Earvin's dad and invites him to the Halloween dance with nearly disastrous results.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E7 — The Goodbye Girl
Mark persuades Geneva to use "reverse psychology" on the rebellious Nicole, and they let her do anything she wants to teach her that rules are important. Vanessa pretends to like sports to impress a man.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E8 — Seoul Shake
Mark learns that Earvin is prejudiced against Koreans when Mark puts a Korean boy on the basketball team.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E9 — The Prince Of Soul
When a man claiming to be an African prince proposes to Vanessa, Mark convinces her that the man is a clever thief trying to cheat them out of their home. Don Cheadle guest stars.

title: Moesha

title: Moesha

Moesha and her father coach Hakeem on how to get a job.  As a result, the owner of a sporting goods store (Bo Jackson) hires him.

title: Moesha

Moesha and Kim attend a church youth group designed to build leadership, but they experience resistance from the leader of the event because they are female.

title: Moesha

Moesha gets her driver’s license but refuses Frank’s gift of a Saturn, preferring to earn her own money for her dream car -- a new Jeep.

description:

description:

When Dee Dee’s ex-boyfriend comes over for the family holiday dinner, he announces that he is getting married, and Mona warns Dee Dee against an effort to win him back.

title: Half & Half
description:
S2 E12 — The Big Double Date With My Mate Episode
When Mona gets set up on a date with Camille’s best friend Carlo (guest star Antonio Sabato Jr.), she is taken by his charm and good looks until he admits he’s actually in love with Camille.

title: Half & Half
description:

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:

Geneva's crazy Aunt Eunetta (also played by SAUNDRA QUARTERMAN) comes to visit and decides that roommates Mark and Vanessa would be the perfect couple. Nicole is upset when Tyler and his friend won't let her play in their boys-only clubhouse.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:

Mark tries to help Geneva's boyfriend become a part of his group of male friends with disastrous results. Nicole hides a stray cat in her room, but Vanessa is allergic to cats.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:

It looks like Mark, Geneva and Vanessa may all be leaving Oakland forever due to some unexpected surprises--good and bad--in this season finale cliffhanger.
